answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral escrow: when k identities coordinate equivocation, aggregate slashing grows as O(k^2), so collusion is superlinearly costly. Detection then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovered stake from restoring influence. Thus a marble, ember, or onyx identity gains no cheap redundancy; correlation makes every additional agent increase systemic exposure.
